The organization's own website shows the same EIN (83-4249837) and an Oakland headquarters, matching the agenda location 'Oakland, CA'
Website describes community and school-based healing clinics, consistent with OUSD's Community Schools and Student Services Department agreements and health-and-wellness funding sources
research.notes: The web search budget was exhausted, so only registry and organization pages were fetched. Website does not name OUSD explicitly; school link rests on its described school-based clinics. Phone is listed with limited hours (Tue 1-6pm, Wed 1-5pm). CA SOS entity number and SAM UEI not checked.

profile.summary: Freedom Community Clinic is an Oakland nonprofit that offers free and sliding-scale health and healing services, including acupuncture, herbalism and other whole-person care. It serves mostly Black, Brown and immigrant communities. It runs community and school-based healing clinics and operates sites in Oakland.

sources.title: Freedom Community Clinic Inc - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: Name, Oakland location, EIN 83-4249837 (ProPublica 501(c)(3), Oakland) and the organization's own site match, and its school-based healing clinics fit OUSD's Community Schools/health-and-wellness agreements, though the site never names OUSD. The listed street address is only one of three sites (the site names Downtown/West Oakland as the hub), so it is dropped; the summary is supported and neutral.
